description.value: Hampton Inn by Hilton Chilliwack is a mid-scale chain hotel located on Lickman Road in the Sardis area of Chilliwack, a common stopover town for cyclists travelling the Fraser Valley corridor. As part of the Hampton by Hilton brand, it offers a standardized full-service hotel experience. Its location near Highway 1 makes it a practical overnight option for touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Hilton website returned error pages ('Something went wrong') for all fetched subpages, so no amenity or contact information could be confirmed from website content. OSM tags confirm a real hotel building (tourism=hotel, building=yes) operated by the Hampton by Hilton brand at 8050 Lickman Road, Sardis. All amenity fields default to null due to the effective fetch failure; the OSM record itself is sufficient to confirm the place is real and open.
concerns: Website fetch failed — all Hilton subpages returned generic error screens ('Something went wrong'); no amenity or contact details could be confirmed from website content.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel from a known brand at a confirmed address; a useful overnight stop for Fraser Valley touring cyclists.
